authorization: 2026-10-10 user resumed research: 持续推进。优先做指标的组合和回测。努力做出一个正向汇报的策略
interpretation: Seek positive net returns, report all results honestly; finite comparison experiment, not permission to weaken costs or risks.
smart_money_definition: Daily signed amount pressure proxy, not identified institutional money or an intraday proprietary formula.
pressure_formula: sum(amount * sign(causal_total_return_change),20) / sum(amount,20); flat days contribute zero numerator and retain amount in denominator
signal_price: forward-built total-return index: previous index * (raw close + cash per unit on ex-date) / previous raw close; no future back-adjustment
macd_formula: EMA12-EMA26 minus its EMA9; adjust=False; min_periods equal each span; divide histogram by same-date total-return index for scale
zscore_reference: preceding 252 sessions excluding today, population standard deviation; zero standard deviation or missing inputs means unknown/cash
decision_clock: first decision is session immediately before first_session; repeat on the frozen session cadence; only information through that close
execution: desired state changes execute next session raw open; no same-day roundtrip; final exit on common terminal open; a signal episode beyond 252 sessions does not re-enter until a new off/on episode
unknown_state: cash target at next scheduled decision; record all unknowns
account_policy: existing comparative_allocation fixed CNY10000 account, same-asset holding and idle cash; max position CNY1000, max daily loss CNY60, paper DD8%, ADV1%, 100-share lots
cost_cases: commission5bp each side, minimum0/5/10CNY crossed with slippage0/10/30bp; primary min5/slip10; no best-cost selection
selection_policy: report every asset/rule/cadence; no fitting, sign flip, threshold change, asset selection, or parameter rescue after results

uncertainty.method: paired circular block bootstrap of continuous evaluation account daily PnL differences
uncertainty.correction: Bonferroni one-sided lower bound across all 16 candidate comparisons

source_limitations: retained historical versions not independently certified point-in-time
daily volume constraint is only an ex-post feasibility check on modeled open fills
execution flags unknown where source did not supply them
broker fees and actual fills not certified
fixed two surviving long-history assets do not support all-ETF population inference
